items.description: Electrician labour for flooded basement circuits
items.rationale: Rainwater entering from outside is inundation under §§2.4–2.5, not escape of water, and no scheduled c2 cover is evidenced. Section 3.6.2(b) therefore bars the labour; the conditional estimate is 12 hours at €85 gross.

Section 3.6.2(f) bars journey charges for this inundation absent evidence of scheduled c2 cover. If cover were established, this first listed journey would qualify under §7.1.7(g) at the €79 gross prior.

Section 3.6.2(d) bars the pumping costs absent evidenced c2 cover. Even with flood cover, §§4.3(d) and 5.2.2 exclude separate procurement of working equipment used for the billed extraction measure; the positive figure is a nominal placeholder.

Section 3.6.2(d) bars this charge absent evidenced c2 cover. Sections 4.3(d) and 5.2.2 also preclude separate payment for the pump alongside the extraction charge; the positive figure is a nominal placeholder.

Sections 3.6.2(d) and 5.1 bar this mitigation measure because no scheduled c2 cover is evidenced. If covered, §5.2.2 would allow one gross charge of about €500 for the extraction, including labour and pump use.

Section 3.6.2(c) bars materials for the inundation loss absent evidenced c2 cover. If covered, §7.1.7(c) would allow about €150 gross for standard materials actually incorporated into the flooded circuits.

items.description: Replace boiler, flue and storage tank
items.rationale: The fixed boiler system is insured property, but §3.6.2(a) bars replacement for inundation absent evidenced c2 cover. If covered, §§7.1.1(c) and 7.1.9 would allow about €10500 gross for a like-for-like installed system, excluding the separately billed pipework adaptation and disposal.

items.description: Adapt supply pipework to replacement boiler
items.rationale: Section 3.6.2(a) expressly bars adaptation work absent evidenced c2 cover. If covered, §7.1.7(d) would allow about €650 gross for necessary alterations to the immediately adjoining pipework.
Section 3.6.2(e) bars disposal absent evidenced c2 cover. If covered, §5.2.1 would allow about €300 gross for ordinary haul-away and disposal of the ruined plant.

Section 3.6.2(f) bars all journeys absent evidenced c2 cover, and §§7.1.7(g) and 7.1.8(d) allow only the first journey across both trades. The €79 gross prior would apply only if this were established as the first eligible charge instead of line 2.
